Definition
[Geodesic]

↗ thm:covariant-derivative-along-curve

The acceleration of $\gamma $ is $D_t\gamma '$. The curve is a geodesic when $D_t\gamma '\equiv 0$, equivalently when its velocity is parallel. Its coordinate functions satisfy (4.16).
